youtube.title: Why planes fly above the weather ✈️ #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Right now, about seven miles above you, thousands of people are eating peanuts. Why up there?

Almost all weather, the clouds, rain and storms, lives in the lowest layer of the sky. Fly near the top of it and you're above most of the bumps. Old propeller airliners couldn't climb that high, so passengers felt every storm. Concorde went even higher, but for the rest of us, 35,000 feet is the sweet spot.
